claims.claim: An httpx.Timeout instance can be passed to the timeout parameter of httpx.Client.
claims.citation: You can configure the timeout behavior for any of these values...

claims.claim: HTTPX timeout exception classes inherit from httpx.TimeoutException.
claims.citation: If HTTPX is unable to connect within this time frame, a `ConnectTimeout` exception is raised.

claims.claim: HTTPX allows timeout values to be set to None to disable timeouts for network operations.
claims.citation: You can configure the timeout behavior for any of these values...

claims.claim: HTTPX supports only four types of timeouts.
claims.citation: There are four different types of timeouts that may occur.

claims.claim: The HTTPX read timeout specifies the maximum duration to wait for an entire response body to be received.
claims.citation: The read timeout specifies the maximum duration to wait for a chunk of data to be received (for example, a chunk of the response body).

claims.claim: The limits argument is used to configure pool timeouts in HTTPX.
claims.citation: A related configuration here is the maximum number of allowable connections in the connection pool, which is configured by the `limits` argument.
